name: adaptive-learning-platform
description: Agentic adaptive learning platform: a deterministic learner model steered by a team of Claude agents.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @alp/engine && npm run build -w @alp/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @alp/engine && npm run test -w @alp/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @alp/engine && npm run typecheck -w @alp/web && npm run typecheck -w @alp/evals
scripts.eval: npm run eval:sim && npm run eval:guards
scripts.eval:llm: npm run eval:verifier && npm run eval:director
